description: Canonical AIDL guardrail baseline for GitHub Project automation rules.

rules.name: Auto-set status to In Progress on PR open
rules.rationale: Ensures all open PRs are immediately visible in the in-progress swim lane, preventing work from being invisible to the team.

rules.name: Auto-set status to Done on PR merge
rules.rationale: Closes work items automatically on merge so the board reflects the true delivery state without manual updates.

rules.name: Auto-set status to Done on issue close
rules.rationale: Mirrors issue closure to the board so completed work is not left in an active swim lane.

rules.name: Auto-archive items when status is Done
rules.rationale: Keeps the active board clean by archiving completed items automatically, reducing cognitive load for operators.

rules.name: Auto-add items with sprint label to project
rules.rationale: Sprint-labeled issues must be tracked in the AIDL project board. Missing this rule causes sprint scope to be invisible to the project view.

rules.name: Auto-set status to Todo on item add
rules.rationale: New items default to Todo status so they are immediately visible in the backlog swim lane.

rules.name: Auto-reopen item when PR is reopened
rules.rationale: Reopened PRs should move back to In Progress to prevent silent staleness on the board.

rules.name: Auto-set status to In Review on review requested
rules.rationale: Tracks PR review state on the board so reviewers can see what requires their attention without reading PR lists.
